data_sources.name: improve_cira_adms
data_sources.label: IMPROVE ADMS exports
data_sources.producer_institution: IMPROVE programme; National Park Service; UC Davis; CIRA, Colorado State University
data_sources.description: Rural/background aerosol-monitoring network plus partner sites, not continuous spatial coverage. Daily sample support on a nominal one-in-three-day schedule is not a three-day composite or daily complete series. Native raw, RHR2 and RHR3 deliveries have different reconstruction/selection/QA semantics and cannot be concatenated as duplicates. Public access; acknowledge IMPROVE and follow provider use/citation guidance. No unsupported SPDX license or universal station datum is assigned.

products.name: improve_raw
products.label: IMPROVE IMPAER native daily records
products.description: 2020 original pipe-delimited annual archive fully inspected for its parameter/unit dictionary. FactValue is a physical measurement or derived metric, not universally aerosol mass. Preserve SiteCode, POC, FactDate, ParamCode, MethodID, Units and Status plus product-specific flags. Raw Unc and MDL have the same units as the corresponding FactValue; do not zero negative or below-MDL observations automatically. Invalid/missing statuses require an explicit row policy; no blanket numeric sentinel was established. RHR HGroup/IGroup distinguish haze versus impairment rankings; their zero means unavailable ranking, not a measured concentration. Patched/substituted values and completeness indicators remain separate. Deciviews are already logarithmic visibility metrics, represented as dimensionless indices, not ug/m3 or inverse megametres. Native R unit on FlowRate/S_Rayleigh remains ambiguous and those bindings are withheld. process_improve preserves statuses without filtering, and selects latest station metadata by SiteCode; historical site moves/datum need explicit review. No calculate_covariates dispatch exists for IMPROVE. CIRA publishes mappings between original flags and delivered Status codes; for example NM and LD map to V0, while QA maps to I1. These are product/version-specific crosswalks, not a universal V0-only acceptance rule or a coordinate-validity history. Use the dictionary accompanying the acquired product, retaining below-detection and missingness context. Reference: https://views.cira.colostate.edu/fed/Pub/DatasetDetail.aspx?dsidse=10001&dssl=1.
products.spatial_extent_descriptor: Monitoring sites present in each archive, including partner locations; no spatial interpolation implied
